name: OpenHU Plugins
description: Official plugins for OpenHU: CAN bus, steering wheel keys, reverse camera, vehicle data logger, FM/AM/DAB+ radio, music player

plugins.name: CAN bus
plugins.description: Vehicle data (speed, gear, lights …) and steering wheel keys from the CAN bus via SocketCAN. Vehicle profiles describe the CAN IDs.

plugins.name: Instrument cluster
plugins.description: Live digital instrument cluster for speed, engine RPM, climate, fuel and vehicle status from the CAN bus.

plugins.name: Display control
plugins.description: Set monitor brightness from CAN and power off the system after ignition-off delay.

plugins.name: Reverse camera
plugins.description: Camera picture with guide lines in the content area or full screen, automatically in reverse gear (CAN plugin) or with the actions camera.show / camera.hide / camera.toggle.

plugins.name: Vehicle data logger
plugins.description: Records vehicle data (from the CAN plugin), Android Auto state and head unit values on the device, detects trips and offers the data to other plugins. Offline, off until switched on.

plugins.name: Music
plugins.description: Music player for USB sticks and the head unit: albums, artists, songs, playlists (M3U, PLS, XSPF and your own) and folders, a queue with order, shuffle and random, gapless playback with mpv. Offline, reads only your own files.

plugins.name: Radio
plugins.description: FM/AM/DAB+ radio with an RTL-SDR USB stick: station scan, favorites, RDS (station name, radio text, PI) and DAB+ with DLS and slideshow (decoders included), station logos from your own image files. For testing without a stick: a simulated stick with internet radio streams.

plugins.name: Steering wheel keys
plugins.description: Keys of input devices (USB steering wheel adapters, IR remote controls, multimedia keyboards) as OpenHU actions, with a learn mode.

plugins.name: Vehicle data
plugins.description: Passes the vehicle data of the CAN plugin (speed, gear, parking brake, fuel …) to Android Auto and to the vehicle topics of OpenHU.
